items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: He took me, he took Cragbrains and Curtis, and Tommy Potter on bass... This was John's band, yeah.

ctx.x: So then he got this gig in...

Yeah. He got one out in Dykes Stockade. When that one was over, John got this job at the Dykes, and then he took six pieces out there. He took me, he took Cragbrains and Curtis, and Tommy Potter on bass...
This was when he took them from 26th Street to the other gig. Is that what you're saying?
